scope: Local Chromium actual built Claw UI at fourfold main-thread CPU slowdown, not production Workers CPU or production API latency.

protocol.sound: on; new browser context and fresh localStorage; no sound override
protocol.measurementOrder: One baseline then three updated trials, sequentially; all unrelated tests, builds and browser jobs stopped during this primary sequence.
protocol.react: Every onCommitFiberRoot callback for the whole app root, not just the parent Claw component. DevTools hook is test-only and injected before React loads.
protocol.canvas: Test-only main canvas clearRect/drawImage/shadowBlur interception; paints counted once per requestAnimationFrame timestamp. Offscreen cache construction is not miscounted as a main canvas repaint.
protocol.settling: Fonts/images/finite entrance animations settled, then 1.2s entry settling. Three-second idle observation. Real right arrow held 1.2s then left 0.6s, with 0.3s deceleration. Result spring/celebration allowed the same fixed 5s in both builds before a 1.5s resting-result observation.
protocol.replay: From JSON body completion of POST /api/claw/play to the first actual canvas paint while the real controller is playing. Includes receipt application, following bootstrap behavior, worker communication and the next animation frame. Network wait before the saved response is excluded. A separate E2E holds the following bootstrap to verify it cannot block playback.
protocol.client: Test-only local API client starts with an authentic isolated D1 bootstrap. Fixed 30-doll board seed1792405194 and unchanged shared physics compute the saved strong result from the actual UI input. No production seed endpoint, API changes or remote calls. Following fake bootstraps reflect saved gold and score rewards, matching the real UI contract.
protocol.referencePhysics: Separate 24-sample main-thread record:true call of the unchanged shared physics module in the same throttled browser. These are calculation-only samples, not the worker replay latency or server CPU. They are outside all UI measurement phases.
protocol.taskHandling: All Long Tasks inside each measured phase retained. No forced GC, task removal, sound suppression, reduced-motion shortcut or warm-up simulation during measured phases.
protocol.observer: Main context detection cached once per context in WeakMap; fixed-arity native canvas calls avoid per-draw temporary rest arrays. Same final harness used for baseline and all three updated trials. Long Task observer and acceptance thresholds are unchanged.

subsequentRefinements: The final application copies only pixel-aligned panel/track regions from static cached surfaces; original artwork, scaling and layer order remain unchanged.
The worker omits only the leading descent frames that the original controller already skipped after displaying the live descent. It still validates the exact shared-engine final result.
Observer context classification and argument forwarding were made allocation-light; both baseline and updated primary trials were rerun with this same harness.

sourceVersions.transparentContextWithConcurrentE2ETrial: Initial cached renderer/DPR2, transparent synchronized main context, full-frame replay transport, selector/rest-array observer; E2E ran concurrently.
sourceVersions.earlierUpdatedTrial: Initial cached renderer/DPR2 before opaque/desynchronized context and ROI/prefix refinements; earlier observer and experimental settling protocol.
sourceVersions.traceRun: Transparent synchronized main context with the earlier observer. Trace evidence motivated opaque/desynchronized context.
sourceVersions.earlierBaselineTrials: Unchanged2f20512 app with earlier observer; includes experimental settling and concurrent browser/build activity.
sourceVersions.opaqueContextBeforeROIPrefixAndObserverR: Earlier isolated baseline+three updated trials after opaque/desynchronized context only; no static-layer ROI or prefix trim, and selector/rest-array observer still active.
sourceVersions.firstFullSuitePerformanceFailure: Opaque/desynchronized context before ROI/prefix refinement, earlier observer; a51ms control task despite earlier isolated passes.
sourceVersions.prefixIndexUnderflow: ROI and suffix-only worker transport plus allocation-light observer, before RAF timestamp clamp; prefix index underflow caused runtime error and timeout. This is a rejected functional trial, not timing acceptance.
sourceVersions.baselineBeforeFailedPrefixCohort: Unchanged2f20512 baseline with final allocation-light observer, recorded before the functional underflow was discovered.

limits: Local headless browser measurements depend on hardware and scheduler load; maximum final isolated replay sample was96.0ms against the100ms target.

Earlier concurrent development loads and one opaque-context full-suite test produced50–72ms control tasks; one concurrent replay was118.3ms. All preserved above; final isolated primary samples use the refined application and same allocation-light observer.
DPR3 is held constant; the application canvas cap intentionally changes3→2. Main context attributes record opaque/desynchronized behavior.
The deterministic replay equivalence tests separately compare exact shared-engine frames and outcomes; timed keyboard input can land at different x values when the slower baseline drops frames.

The final control samples had no Long Tasks but did include isolated paint-to-paint gaps up to133.3ms (per-trial maxima50.0/99.9/133.3ms). Median16.7ms and p95≈33.4ms do not imply a guaranteed16.7ms interval for every frame.
